film_possessions.film_note: From about 10 to 8 seconds before the turnover, both defenders follow the ball handler into a sideline trap while the screener releases to the middle. The handler passes out and the possession later ends in a turnover.

From about 6 to 1 seconds before the make, the screener's defender takes the handler and contests the shot. The original guard defender follows the screener toward the lane. The prior offensive rebound is part of the same possession.
From about 6 to 2 seconds before the make, the screener's defender takes the handler on the wing and follows him to the pull-up. The original guard defender follows the screener after the exchange.

From about 5 to 3 seconds before the turnover, the screener's defender leaves the roll to close on the handler along with the original ball defender. Both stay with the handler near midcourt until he passes out.

film_samples.film_scope: First-quarter ball screens · one Phoenix ball handler

film_possessions.film_note: The screener's defender stays below the screen and follows the roll. The on-ball defender remains with the handler; offensive rebounds stay in the possession.
The big starts below the wing screen, steps to meet the drive inside the arc, then recovers to the roller as the guard trails.
The big contains from below the high screen and the guard trails. The offense keeps possession after a nonshooting foul.
The screen defender stays in the lane on the pull-up; the original on-ball defender recovers to contest. The offensive rebound and the later score stay in this possession.
Two defenders converge after the screen. The clip does not distinguish a sustained two-man trap from a short show and recovery.
The first interaction is a brief show with the ball rejected away from the screen; no drop, switch or blitz was assigned.
